title: @csp/clean non-destructive transforms + change-ledger (normalize/dedupe/convert/parse)
context: Cleaning must be non-destructive and auditable: originals are never silently mutated, and every change is recorded in a reversible change-ledger with the rule that caused it. Crucially, cleaning corrects format/encoding/duplication but never imputes or fabricates scientific observations. Determinism is preserved so cleaned output + ledger are byte-identical on replay. Depends on csp-validate-005.
objective: Implement @csp/clean non-destructive transforms (normalize/canonicalize, deduplicate, unit-convert, date-parse) that append a ChangeLedgerEntry for every change, leave the input content hash unchanged, and never impute or fabricate values.
acceptanceCriteria: Every transform appends a ChangeLedgerEntry (recordId, field, before, after, ruleId, reversible); the input artifact's content hash is unchanged after a run (test-enforced)
Provides normalize/canonicalize, deduplicate, unit-convert, date-parse; never imputes or fabricates values; deduplication records which record was kept and why
Deterministic: same input + spec yields byte-identical cleaned output + ledger
pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint pass; changeset added
output: A PR adding the @csp/clean package with non-destructive transforms, the change-ledger, and the input-content-hash-unchanged test.
